name: xampp-studio
description: Gerenciador local para instalar, ativar e trocar versões de Apache, PHP e MySQL/MariaDB no Windows, com validação e reversão automática.

scripts.build: npm run build:js && npm run build:css
scripts.test: node tests/run-tests.cjs && node --test tests/extension-catalog.cjs && node tests/admin-targets.cjs && powershell.exe -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File tests/start-safety.ps1
